description.value: Strawberry Island is a unique floating-cabin resort located on a small island just 30 seconds by water taxi from downtown Tofino, offering three rentable cabins (Halibut House, Seabass Suite, Yellow House) as well as ocean fishing charters and island adventure tours including Hot Springs Cove. The operation has over 15 years of experience and is a distinctly West Coast experience combining private island accommodation with guided ocean activities. Access is exclusively by water, so touring cyclists would need to arrange bike transport to reach the cabins.

address.value: 4th St, Strawberry Island Tofino, BC V0R 2Z0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and detailed, confirming an active floating-cabin resort and charter operation on Strawberry Island, accessible only by water taxi (30 seconds from downtown Tofino by boat). The cabins page explicitly lists WiFi as an included amenity. No mention of bike storage, cycling procedures, laundry, e-bike charging, or any other cycling-specific amenity appears anywhere on the site; the water-only access means conventional cycle touring access to the property is not possible.
concerns: Property is accessible by water taxi only (30-second boat ride from downtown Tofino); there is no land/cycling access to the island itself. Touring cyclists would need to transport bikes by boat.
OSM record has no phone or address; both sourced from website only — contact_confirmed fields cannot be cross-validated against OSM.
OSM name ('Strawberry Island Stays Tours Charters') differs slightly from the website branding ('Strawberry Island' / 'Strawberry Island CHARTERS | TOURS | STAYS') but refers to the same operation.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly bookable business confirmed via a detailed website with booking forms, cabin listings, and contact details. The water-taxi-only access is unusual for a cycling directory but does not preclude inclusion — touring cyclists may choose to visit as a destination.

wow_evidence: unique floating-cabin resort... accessible only by water taxi (30 seconds from downtown Tofino)

price.label: Mid-range
price.signal: three floating cabins by water taxi from Tofino, inquire-for-pricing; banded conservatively
